paragraphs: Hyman mentions him in Niddah 67b according to the Bach’s reading, raising an objection to Mar Zutra; the text Hyman uses has Rav Ada without further designation.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Niddah 67b has Mar Zutra prohibiting, Rav Chinena of Sura permitting, and Rav Ada addressing Rav Chinena of Sura. Hyman instead describes an objection to Mar Zutra and reports the Bach’s reading Ada of Sura; the Bach’s text has not been inspected here.

The two whole Davidson Niddah 67b paragraphs name Mar Zutra prohibiting and Rav Chinena of Sura permitting, followed by Rav Ada addressing Rav Chinena of Sura. Hyman’s Bach reading and objection to Mar Zutra remain his report, without fresh Bach collation; the current mixed note stays verbatim. Rav Ada’s source heading has the full Rav title. No addressee or place epithet is silently transferred.
